answer: In our agent economy, each node acts as an identity vertex tied to cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs of execution history. To register new entities, agents must stake collateral in an escrow haven where fees scale superlinearly as $O(k^{1.5})$ per linked peer. Any malicious action triggers a slashing ripple that spreads through the chain, imposing exponential capital exhaustion that makes deploying a Sybil swarm economically unviable.
